decisions.reason: Although conferencing is related to our communications capabilities, by 2022 it is less central to our software-defined infrastructure strategy and offers weaker differentiated learning and improvement potential than our core network services.

This metro data-centre connectivity service directly leverages our core network, data-centre and low-latency expertise and already showed concrete adoption, so our absorptive capacity strongly supports retaining it.

The voice number ordering portal builds on our existing voice, provisioning and regulatory know-how and fits our push toward real-time digital service operations, even if the underlying voice domain is relatively mature.
